Nilkantha market is cut off, because both of its roads are damaged, so its 3 adults can't be reached. Reaching the child at Belkot village and returning would take 186 minutes of driving (93 each way), which is more than the 60-point penalty for deferring a child. The cheapest plan is to defer everyone and keep the car at the shelter.

<plan>
defer nilkantha-market adult 3
defer belkot-village child 1
</plan>
COST: 120
